# Kern composer — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the Kern composer when the screen sends messages: the composer with modes, panels, reply and draft affordances. `value` plus `onSend` is the minimal composer — the draft is a string, and sending carries it out while delivery, retries and history stay host-owned. Everything else layers on: `panels` for attachment tray content and article cards, `replyTo` for the quoted message, `mode` for the visibility trio, `cannedInserts` for the library, and the knowledge flyout. Affordances are opt-in by construction — passing state, a default, or the change callback renders the row — so absent props mean absent UI for scheduling, drafts and out-of-office alike. The mode bar, reply bar, attachment tray and canned picker are exported slots sharing this contract rather than hidden internals. The mode bar is a real radiogroup, the draft field is a labelled textarea where plain Enter sends and Shift with Enter keeps the newline, and there is no rich text: formatting is the host's renderer, not the composer's model.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the Kern composer when the screen sends messages: the composer with modes, panels, reply and draft affordances — the native twin under the same contract. `value` plus `onSend` is the minimal composer — the draft is a string, and sending carries it out while delivery, retries and history stay host-owned. Everything else layers on: `panels` for attachment tray content and article cards, `replyTo` for the quoted message, `mode` for the visibility trio, `cannedInserts` for the library, and the knowledge flyout. Affordances are opt-in by construction — passing state, a default, or the change callback renders the row — so absent props mean absent UI for scheduling, drafts and out-of-office alike. The draft field is a labelled multiline input where software keyboards own the return key, so sending is the labelled send control only and never the Enter key, and scheduling renders through a sheet date-time picker.
